abstract:
BACKGROUND: Current guidelines do not recommend routine sampling of lymph node stations (LNS) 16b1, 9, and 8a during pancreatoduodenectomy for pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) and other periampullary cancers because prospective multicentre studies are lacking. This study evaluated the association between the involvement of these LNS and overall survival (OS).
METHODS: This prospective multicentre study included patients undergoing pancreatoduodenectomy for PDAC, distal cholangiocarcinoma, ampullary cancer, or duodenal cancer between October 2015 and April 2020. Associations between involvement of LNS 16b1, 9, and 8a and OS were analysed using multivariable Cox regression analyses.
RESULTS: Among 1218 included patients, 673 had PDAC, 228 had distal cholangiocarcinoma, 212 had ampullary cancer, and 105 had duodenal cancer. LNS 16b1 involvement was associated with worse OS in PDAC (10 versus 24 months; adjusted hazard ratio (aHR) 2.33; 95% confidence interval (c.i.) 1.62 to 3.35), distal cholangiocarcinoma (7 versus 28 months; aHR 6.95; 95% c.i. 2.88 to 16.77), ampullary cancer (9 versus 62 months; aHR 4.35; 95% c.i. 1.73 to 10.94), and duodenal cancer (13 months versus endpoint not reached; aHR 3.95; 95% c.i. 1.15 to 13.47). LNS 8a involvement was associated with worse OS in PDAC (13 versus 22 months; aHR 1.38; 95% c.i. 1.03 to 1.86), distal cholangiocarcinoma (16 versus 26 months; aHR 1.68; 95% c.i. 1.00 to 2.81), and ampullary cancer (16 versus 62 months; aHR 2.89; 95% c.i. 1.51 to 5.53). LNS 9 involvement was associated with worse OS only in ampullary cancer (4 versus 35 months; aHR 8.19; 95% c.i. 2.34 to 28.57).
CONCLUSION: LNS 16b1 involvement was associated with poor OS in PDAC and periampullary cancer. Future studies should assess routine preoperative and intraoperative sampling of LNS 16b1 and the impact of neoadjuvant treatment.
key_points_ko: 췌장관선암 환자에서 16b1 림프절 침범은 전체 생존기간 단축과 유의한 연관이 있었습니다(10개월 대 24개월, 보정 위험비 2.33).
췌장관선암 환자에서 8a 림프절 침범 역시 전체 생존기간 감소와 관련이 있었습니다(13개월 대 22개월, 보정 위험비 1.38).
본 연구에는 췌장관선암 환자 673명을 포함해 총 1,218명의 절제술 환자가 분석되었습니다.
summary_ko: 췌장관선암(PDAC) 및 팽대부위암 환자를 대상으로 췌두십이지장절제술 시 림프절 구역(LNS) 16b1, 9, 8a의 침범이 전체 생존기간(OS)에 미치는 영향을 평가한 전향적 다기관 연구입니다. 총 1,218명의 환자(췌장관선암 673명 포함)를 분석한 결과, 16b1 림프절 침범은 췌장관선암 환자의 생존기간을 현저히 단축시켰습니다. 림프절 8a 침범 역시 췌장관선암 환자의 생존기간 감소와 연관이 있었습니다. 연구진은 수술 전 또는 수술 중 16b1 림프절 검사의 필요성을 평가해야 한다고 결론지었습니다.
title: Survival impact of involvement of lymph node stations 16b1, 9, and 8a during pancreatoduodenectomy for pancreatic and periampullary cancers (PANODE): prospective multicentre study
